Each package coordinates concise notes, a teaching deck, five student questions, formula and calculator references, and an experiment or explicit no-lab decision. Restricted answer keys are identified without exposing their files. Use the [circuit foundations reference](../circuits/index.qmd) for significant figures, notation, core equations, and the GUESS method.

## Shared student resources

- [TEJ Electronics Quick Reference](https://andrewandrade.ca/assets/TEJ-Electronics-Quick-Reference.pdf)
- [Standard 5% Resistor Values, page 2](https://andrewandrade.ca/assets/TEJ-Electronics-Quick-Reference.pdf#page=2)
- [Make a copy of the General Schematic and GUESS Handout](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1RCkfqUT5U0FMKTOJ_ScyiDLmiGF-bCpyo-6y6Pm8ZUo/copy)
- [Student circuits lesson folder](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NWvgVWTRJ9oHrWCLrAia8LP-1lxUvfdZ)
